object.attr: A strap that leaves range or is not yet awake is expected to return, so attempts continue for the rest of the session. A failed attempt counts as a lost connection. An attempt may stay in progress until the strap wakes, so that it reconnects as soon as it does, instead of starting a new attempt on a schedule. Owner decision, 2026-10-31. Basis: owner decision.
object.description: When the connection to the paired sensor is lost, the app shall leave no more than 30 s without a connection attempt in progress until the session ends or PACE-SRS-83 applies.
